recycle.help.retention.title: Recycle bin retention
recycle.help.retention.short: Deleted content stays in the recycle bin for this many days.
recycle.help.retention.detail:
Deleted content stays here for this many days, then is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
0 keeps it forever and disables automatic cleanup. After changing the number, click Save next to it; the app cleans up once with the new period and then checks every 5 minutes.
To clear it now, select items and click Delete Selected Permanently.
recycle.help.operations.title: Recycle bin actions
recycle.help.operations.short: Select All, Restore Selected and Delete Selected Permanently only affect the current section's selection.
recycle.help.operations.detail:
Select All selects everything in this section; Restore Selected returns items to their workspace; Delete Selected Permanently removes them for good.
To select all three sections together, use Select All in the top bar.
You can also right-click one item to restore or delete it alone.
